summary_1line: Bhishma tells Yudhishthira that reciting the names of gods, sages, sacred places, and cosmic powers purifies sins and brings spiritual benefit.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhishma lies on a bed of arrows on the battlefield while Yudhishthira stands beside him listening to sacred teachings.
A devotee at dawn recites the names of gods as the sun rises, surrounded by imagined visions of deities, rivers, and mountains.
